map_info.name: CA Rules Lab
map_info.description: The 1D-cellular-automata lab. A single instrument — ca_rules_workbench — sits at the north end of the room. One slider scrubs Wolfram rule R in [0,255]; the 256x256 evolution panel redraws live; the class indicator lamp shifts QFEP phase color (Class 1 blue / 2 green / 3 orange / 4 red). At rule 30 the lamp glows orange and a cross-reference points back to shannon_workbench. At rule 110 it goes red and points to halting_workbench (Cook's 2004 universality proof). At rule 90 the panel draws Sierpinski. The dial makes Wolfram's four-class landscape walkable: a single integer step can sit you across a class boundary. Built 2026-05-20 as a centerpiece map paired with /ca-rules-gallery.

learning_objectives: 1D Wolfram CA: 8 transition bits per rule, 256 rules total
Four classes (uniform/periodic/chaotic/edge-of-chaos) map to QFEP phases
Class boundaries can be one-bit flips apart in rule space (e.g. 30 -> 31, 110 -> 111)
